overview.title: Dunas pequeñas, arena de verdad
overview.p1: Las dunas de Tinfou no igualan a Erg Chigaga en escala, pero ofrecen arena sahariana real cerca de Zagora.
overview.p2: Los días concurridos parecen un parque; temprano o tarde es más tranquilo. Combina con Tamegroute.
overview.p3: Lleva agua y zapatos cerrados; es un aperitivo, no todo el desierto.

3.title: Mejor color
3.desc: Luz cálida sobre palmeras y arena.

q1.question: How far from Zagora?
q1.answer: Roughly 25–30 km south — confirm current drive time.

q2.question: Camel rides?
q2.answer: Often offered on site; agree price and duration before you mount.

q3.question: Good for kids?
q3.answer: Yes for a short climb and play — supervise on steep faces.

q4.question: Sunset?
q4.answer: Popular; arrive before the peak light if you want space.

q5.question: Overnight?
q5.answer: Possible nearby; many visitors come for a few hours only.
